prospective_change: A separate quarantined acquisition/format-compatibility experiment permits unknown compressed length and unknown publisher digest algorithm; it does not satisfy or amend V1.

prospective_transfer.runtime: previously signed/hash-verified native arm64 Aspera SDK client; credentials memory/child environment only
prospective_transfer.retention: inert regular compressed file only; no decode or automatic promotion

cap_assessment.official_features_found: rate ceiling and job-size precalculation; neither establishes a hard transfer-byte budget
cap_assessment.proposed_enforcement: OS RLIMIT_FSIZE=64MiB for the client, one exact regular-file destination, fresh quarantine, process-group/time supervision, final file-count/type/size checks after all writers stop
cap_assessment.aggregate_meaning: For accepted output there is exactly one compressed image, so its file cap is also the accepted image-payload aggregate cap. Unexpected extra files or surviving writers fail.
cap_assessment.limits: This is not a bound on network traffic including retransmissions, nor a proven whole-directory disk quota for all transient side files. If a strict transient aggregate-storage quota is required, a separately reviewed OS quota/container is an additional prerequisite. No claim of a native Aspera byte-limit flag.
cap_assessment.supported_acquisition_route_assessment: Yes: official signed FASP client against the legitimate public package is a supported transfer route, already exercised on its checksum index. This V2 is a bounded retained-payload compatibility experiment, not a passed V1 gate or verified clinical image.

compatibility_test.required_comparison: candidate MD5 must equal the exact published token with no padding or transformation
compatibility_test.also_record: actual measured byte length and new local SHA256
compatibility_test.mismatch: failed experiment; retain quarantined diagnostic receipt, no retry, no alternate digest/decoded-byte probing
compatibility_test.match: format/byte-domain compatibility evidence only; does not by itself verify patient identity, modality, anatomy, or dataset semantic correctness

acceptance_layers: Authenticated transport: provider-issued token and exact reviewed public-to-server source mapping; successful client completion.
Compatible checksum: observed candidate MD5 of compressed bytes matches published token; algorithm remains an explicitly unconfirmed source claim.

Independent byte/provenance reconciliation: separate reviewer checks source/version/license/mapping/index binding, immutable original bytes, measured length, MD5 comparison and SHA256 before any header decode is authorized.
Image identity/scientific usability: deferred header/grid/modality/anatomical QC; no route, injury, training or evaluation use from acquisition or digest compatibility alone.
failure_rules: Any cap/time/client failure, unexpected path/type/file, leftover writer, or candidate-digest mismatch is unaccepted.
No implicit retry or extra image; protocol retransmission is not claimed absent.
Incomplete bytes are never decoded, used scientifically, or called checksum-verified.

future_decode_caps_only_after_separate_r.rules: Validate integer dimension/product/datatype/offset bounds before allocation; bounded streaming decompression, reject truncation or excess members/output. No decoding authorized by this proposal.

static_evidence.prior_os_file_cap_test: tests/test_rhuh_checksum_acquisition.py::test_os_file_limit_actually_bounds_child_write (65,536-byte control; the 64 MiB variant remains to be implemented/tested)
